description: Anonymous numeric user identifier (1-504). No names, age, gender or location are stored, so the model learns only from rating behaviour.
Film title. Indian regional films plus English titles taken from MovieLens 100K (leading articles moved to the front, year removed).
Primary genre of the film (e.g. Action, Comedy, Drama, Romance, Sci-Fi, Thriller, Horror, Animation, Crime).
Original language of the film (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali, Marathi, Punjabi, English).
Explicit rating given by the user, on a 1.0-5.0 scale (0.5 steps for Indian titles, whole numbers for MovieLens titles). Higher = liked more.
When the rating was submitted. Rows are sorted in strictly increasing time order (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-01), which allows a time-based train/test split.
